claims.label: supported
claims.claim_summary: RA improves base algorithms in all 24 benchmark comparisons across models.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: With Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base students and a Qwen3-8B teacher, RA combined with GRPO or REINFORCE++ improves the underlying sequence-advantage algorithm in all 24 comparisons on three mathematical benchmarks, raising macro Avg@8 by 1.7–3.6 points and Pass@8 by 3.9–6.3 points.

evidence_spans.source_text: Table 1 contains 24 comparisons of RA with its base estimator (two students, two estimators, three benchmarks, two metrics), and RA improves all 24 three-seed means. The macro gains are 1.74–3.58 Avg@8 and 3.89–6.33 Pass@8 points (Table 10).

claims.label: supported
claims.claim_summary: RA outperforms teacher-only OPD, and Co-RA provides additional performance gains.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: Both combinations surpass teacher-only OPD, and Co-RA adds a further 1.0–1.5 Avg@8 points.

evidence_spans.source_text: Both RA combinations exceed teacher-only OPD in macro Avg@8 and Pass@8 at both sizes, by 1.80–2.96 and 2.73–3.90 points (Table 10).
Co-RA adds 1.03–1.45 macro Avg@8 points to the four RA runs, and Avg@8 rises in all twelve benchmark means.

claims.label: supported
claims.claim_summary: RA guidance naturally fades as student and teacher distributions converge.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: And it is bounded by the student–teacher distance times the probability the student leaves to other tokens, so guidance fades on its own as the two converge.

evidence_spans.source_text: At the fixed weight λ = 10, the recorded mean absolute guidance term falls from about 0.43 to about 0.30 over training (Figure 5a).

claims.label: supported
claims.claim_summary: Co-RA's adapted teacher becomes a worse solver but a better guide.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: Yet each adapted teacher scores 0.8–2.3 macro Avg@8 and 0.7–3.5 Pass@8 points below the frozen teacher (Appendix D.9), while the students it guides improve: it is a better guide, not a better solver.

evidence_spans.source_text: Every adapted teacher scores below the frozen teacher, by 0.8–2.3 macro Avg@8 and 0.7–3.5 Pass@8 points
Co-RA adds 1.03–1.45 macro Avg@8 points to the four RA runs, and Avg@8 rises in all twelve benchmark means.

claims.label: supported
claims.claim_summary: RA's advantage over baselines expands significantly up to Pass@512.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: From K = 8 to K = 512 for the 1.7B REINFORCE++ runs (Appendix D.7), the macro margin of RA over the untrained student grows from 13.4 to 16.9 points, and its margins over REINFORCE++ and OPD from 5.8 to 10.4 and from 3.9 to 6.8, while that of verifier-only training narrows from 7.6 to 6.6, as Yue et al. (2025) report for RLVR.

claims.label: supported
claims.claim_summary: RA improves performance over verifier-only training across all tested weights.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: All tested weights improve both macro scores over verifier-only training (Table 2).

evidence_spans.source_text: Every residual variant improves on verifier-only training at every tested weight, and full RA stays above every control at every matched weight.

claims.label: supported
claims.claim_summary: Ablating RA baselines or adding direct peak supervision reduces accuracy.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: Removing either baseline, replacing the residual by the log ratio, or adding direct supervision of the teacher’s top token lowers performance.

evidence_spans.source_text: Removing the student value baseline lowers both macro scores, by 2.09 Avg@8 and 3.58 Pass@8 points at the reference weight and similarly at weights 5 and 20 (Table 2).
Restoring response centering at the same weight adds 0.54 Avg@8 and 0.46 Pass@8 points, a smaller gain that holds at all three weights (Table 2).

With both operations, clipped to [−5, 5] or not, the log ratio stays above verifier-only training at every swept weight, and the probability residual is better still, by 1.21 Avg@8 and 1.70 Pass@8 points over the best log variant.

Added to RA, it lowers macro Avg@8 by 2.05–2.16 points and Pass@8 by 3.41–3.91 points, and at every weight each seed falls below the same seed of RA, whereas doubling RA’s own weight does not (Table 2).
